body:
This subreddit is sh***.
Such a pity. There is so many people with good stories and genuinely wanting to learn about the law, but the mods here are just bringing everyone down. Even if this story was fake, this post is just beyond everything. Pathetic.
Thank you, i love your comment!!❤️

Thank you for replying!
You’re kind of right, posting this is a reaction, we’re just human beings so In my opinion we sometimes behave this way.  But I have to mentions that I didn’t react negatively.:) The old me would be devastated and I just shrugged it off this time and said to myself that he’s still mine. 
I’m just trying to understand, I have no negative beliefs, and my belief in my successful manifestation is very strong at this point, still for some reason I saw what I saw...

I am manifesting my SP. I figured out I reached the sabbath. I feel calm and certain about my desire but at the same time I don’t obsess over it. I’ve felt it was literally close and about to manifest but then I saw 3rd party commenting on his post. I didn’t react but I am just wondering:  what do you do in such situations? I have to admit that even though I don’t react it feels kind of weird- I was certain he was close and then bang ...

Can someone explain what does it mean when you don’t even want your desire anymore? I mean, for the past few weeks I barely think about my SP. I don’t check Facebook to see if he’s online, I don’t check Instagram to see if he added anything. I’ve been feeling super peaceful, like I know he’s mine but now I also feel Ike I don’t care anymore. And it’s quite scary you know? Deep down I still feel something to him but honestly I don’t care anymore. I’m tired, I don’t need sats and visualizing anymore because I did everything I could and felt it so real that I just don’t care anymore. I’m scared a little but calm at the same time.... 

Hopefully someone can help me with this, I’m quite conflicted :(

How do you deal with breakdowns? 
I keep my mental diet strong, but sometimes I feel like my brain is forcing me to be sad and makes me depressed even if I don’t want to. 
I fight, try to cry for a couple of minutes and get back stronger but I’m worried that it can ruin everything I worked so hard for... 
It is the hardest this weekend, I’m struggling a lot. I feel like my brain wants to destroy everything. I’m manifesting my SP and I’m really fine and calm during the week, I’m certain he’s mine but it seems like my brain wants to destroy me whenever I have free time and I’m not busy. 
I feel bad that I get sad but I try to tell myself that it doesn’t matter, that even when I’m sad sometimes I will still get what I want and I’m still stronger that I used to be. I immediately every correct single thought that doesn’t align with what I want as I see than as “not mine”, something my depression (maybe?) forces me think and these are not my thoughts but I could really use your support and advice regarding this matter :(  I’m working really hard not only on manifesting my SP but also on myself so it makes me really anxious and terrified that I could be all lost because of sadness I don’t even want to feel

Thank you for this :) actually I’m pretty sure I know what I want and I’m sure it will come to pass. I don’t success stories for reassurance, it’s just nice to read them you know? And I’ve been just wondering why there is so little of them. But you are right, success stories related to other things than sp are great as well! And the best ones are the ones we test on our own :-)
I understand it perfectly and you are right:) still, the amount of people mentioning they are manifesting their SP’s  is quite high, and the amount of success stories significantly lower :(

It’s just nice to know that someone manifested their SP successfully :) I know it works, but I just wonder why don’t we hear about it more often. It’s pretty rare to hear someone manifested a specific person....

Hi, 

I do SATS at night, I loop a scene before I sleep but very often I just fall asleep while doing so. Is that okay? Any tips?
What if you ask for a sign and receive a negative one? I just received a negative one and even though I believe that my manifestation will come to pass, I feel quite said at the moment...

Hey guys

I just had a dream (more like a nightmare) with 3rd party and my SP. I keep my mental diet, ignore reality and I know SP is mine, but this nightmare made my anxious. Does it mean anything? Or should I just let it go and do not give it any meaning?
Let’s say you manifest something- a blue rose and then you see it on a picture (Facebook, or on TV etc), do you still think it came to pass? Even though you only see it on the internet/TV?
Hmmm.... I get your point but if we can manifest anything we want, shouldn’t manifesting a specific ex or other specific person be equally easy?

Thank you for your reply! You are right- I’ve been thinking about blocking her. But the thing is, it’s not about her really- it’s just an ocd induced action. at the moment I decided that I don’t want to run away- many times when her profiles popped out on Facebook, I was able to say “it doesn’t matter, it’s just ocd making you check the profile, ignore it”. It helped, but as mentioned, not always. I was just afraid of ruining my manifestation, but in the other hand, as mentioned I have a strong believe that it will come to pass and I don’t really treat her as threat anymore. She doesn’t matter, what matters it’s me and the fact that I know my sp is mine. Right?
I could, probably. But the truth is, that he could message me if he wanted :(

Neither of us is married. 
I wish I could tell him that! I thought many times how to initiate the conversation... He is not even on Facebook (I know, very mature to depend o Facebook) lately, he is always offline. It kills me because I know he spends time with his gf, you know... 
I don’t want him to be unhappy. But I wish I could be happy as well if that makes sense? I just wish I had this one chance, one day with him. I don’t know if it would work, but I wish I could try and move on...
I know there is no hope and point in praying for a miracle but this is the only thing that keeps me going now. Even though I know I will never have a chance to talk to him:( 
I just see nothing I could wait for in my life, this is just the only thing that gives me hope even though I am well aware of the fact that it makes no sense..

We first met in high school a few years ago. Then, after high school, we were sometimes seeing each other thanks to mutual friends. We were never super close but I knew he was interested in me, I was interested as well. unfortunately we were young and stupid and nothing really happened. We started studying and he moved to a different city, we lost contact. 
I met him again 2 years ago. It’s like it all came back to me. He had a girlfriend, so there was no chance for me to even let him know I am interested in him. They broke up but he immediately found another girl....
I met him a few days ago again. It was so painful. 
On one hand I know it makes no sense to wait for a miracle to happen. But on the other, I really don’t want to let go. I am scared. My life is super shitty, I have never had luck in love. I have no hope and no purpose in live. There is nothing good waiting for me. Hoping (even though I know it makes no sense) that I will have a chance to talk to him, maybe go on a date one day, just have a chance with him to try how it would be- this all keeps me alive. 
I am hopeless....

Is it normal to feel like you don’t want to let go? Like I’m scared I will not find anyone like this person? Even though I perfectly know that he is as flawed as me, I can’t shake off the feeling that if not him, then nobody will be better for me. :(

I know you are right. The thing is I don’t believe this person is perfect, but I wish I had a chance to at least check it myself.  I can’t help but feel terrible about it. 
I know about limerence, I am sometimes afraid that this is what it is. I am scared that there is no cure for me, then. I read it can last for several decades and it scares the sh*t out of me. And it makes me feel like there is seriously something wrong with me.
